Class ScopedAnalysisInputLocation

java.lang.Object
sootup.core.inputlocation.ScopedAnalysisInputLocation
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, AnalysisInputLocation
public abstract class ScopedAnalysisInputLocation extends Object implements AnalysisInputLocation
Base class for filtering ClassSources returned from the underlying AnalysisInputLocation. Either override the filter function - e.g. in an anonymous class - or use of(AnalysisInputLocation, Predicate).

Scoping is useful to analyze only parts of a large input, or to treat parts of one input differently, e.g. to load selected packages of a runtime library as application classes: 

Predicate<ClassType> included = type -> type.getPackageName().getName().startsWith("java.util");
List<AnalysisInputLocation> locations = Arrays.asList(
    ScopedAnalysisInputLocation.of(new JavaClassPathAnalysisInputLocation(rtJar, SourceType.Application), included),
    ScopedAnalysisInputLocation.of(new JavaClassPathAnalysisInputLocation(rtJar, SourceType.Library), included.negate()));
